tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i ngag 'don khyer bde ba bzhugs/

oṃ swa stī/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir bzlog ni 'di yin te/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ swā bhā wa= dang*/ shu n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la/ /bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ser/ khong stong g.yas su drag tu 'khor/ /rtse mor rab rno lte ba dang*/ /rtsibs bcur pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan/ /kun gyi steng du hūṃ yig ni/ /lha rnams so so'i rang mdog can/ /de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ /gdug can thams cad tshar bcad nas/ /tshur 'dus so sor thim pa las/ /rang nyid hūṃ mdzad he ru ka /mthing ka sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ /rtsa phyag hūṃ mdzad phyag rgya yi/ /rdo rje dril bu thugs kar 'dzin/ /tha mas glang lpags stod g.yogs bsnams/ /'jigs byed dang ni dus mtshan dag/g.yas rkyang zhabs kyis mnan te bzhugs/ khro mo'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma/ /rang dang mtshungs pas 'khyud par gyur/ /shar du rdo rje gtum po ni/ /nag po nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ /byang du rdo rje nyi ma ni/ /ser po zhal sum ser nag ljang*/ /nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar/ /ban+dhu sprin nag dur ba'i mdog/lho phyogs rdo rje 'khyil ba ljang*/ /mar gad zla ba gser gyi mdog/shar lhor rdo rje gnod sbyin ni/ /dud kha zhal gsum dud ser ljang*/ /lho nub rdo rje dus dmar po/ /dmar dang ser dang ljang khu'o/ /rlung du stobs chen sku mdog nag /nag ser pa la sha yi mdog /dbang ldan rdo rje 'jigs rung sngo/ /nag ser ljang la mig kyang yo/ /brgyad po de rnams rtsa phyag gnyis/ /cang te'u dang ni dril bu bsnams/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur/ /dkar po dkar nag ljang pa'i zhal/ /rtsa phyag 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og nag /dkar min ser dang ljang khu'o/ /rtsa phyag rtse sum dril bu 'dzin/

/kun kyang rang mtshungs yum gyis 'khyud/ /phyogs skyong bcu po chung mar bcas/ /so so'i zhabs kyi 'og tu brdzis/ khro bo'i rgyal po bcu gcig rnams/ /phyag drug g.yas kyi lhag ma gnyis/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin/ /g.yon gnyis thod khrag kha ṭ+waṃ ga /rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsi+egs/ khro gnyer g.yo zhing ljags kyang 'gril/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra 'bar/ /stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris shing*/ /phyag rgya drug dang klu chen brgyad/ /mi mgo'i do shal cod paṇa can/ / gnod byed thams cad zhal du gsol/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ / lha dang 'byung po kun la sdig /'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ bam dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hri mom dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par oṃ hreṃ hriṃ ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza o a/ gau ra de ma/ ka au tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri sau su/ na si ma ku/ oṃ spyi bor sku yi rdo rje dkar/ /āḥmagrin par gsung gi rdo rje dmar/ /hūṃ thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje mthing*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ /rang dang 'dra ba'i bsrung 'khor ni/ khro bo'i tshogs bcas mdun du byon/ /phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba d+dharma yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/

dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe la sogs pa lngas mchod/ khyed rnams kyi bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam= nas sa ma ya shri hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gtum po la rnam snang*/ nyi ma la rin 'byung*/ gtsug tor la snang mtha'/ 'khyil ba la don grub/ gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ= la sogs pas mchod/ hūṃ 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa'i rdo rje ni/ /drag gtum mi bzad ma rung thams cad 'joms/ /he ru ka dpal mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /rdo rje khro tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / spro zhing nus na yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ oṃ kha badz+ra d+dhig badz+ra hūṃ ka badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lārka badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+roṣ+ṇi ṣa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ba le badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhī ṣa ṇa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ta la badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de ltar na sngags bcu gcig po ci rigs pa dang*/ sum bha mang du bzla/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ khwa gdong ma las steng du khwa gdong ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma las 'og tu khyi gdong ma rnams dmar mo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/ yang na sku mdog so sor byas kyang rung ngo*/ /sum bha sogs lan gnyis/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces bka' sgos pas/ pho nya rnams kyis bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems la bkod/

nag po'i rigs can kha cig ni bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur mkhod/ hūṃ las phur bu/ bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag par btad/ bgegs kyi spyi bor btsugs/ oṃ gha gha ghā tā ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+taṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bi gha na kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yang hūṃ las tho ba bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/ phur bus spyi bor brdung*/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra kī la a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyis bar thal byung nas/ de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom nas 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur zhing*/ smon lam gyi mthu las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ me dhi na badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūṃ/ de las phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa las rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa'i ra ba dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng la song ba'i dra ba/ hūṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ paṃ hūṃ/ steng du 'phros pa las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba'i gur/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra bi ta na hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ de'i phyi rol du 'obs dang bcas pa'i mda'i dra ba mde'u rno ba srid pa'i rtse mo la thug par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dza la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i/ me ri 'bar ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na larka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ pho nya rnams las rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros/ rdo rje'i dra mig nas phar ro stod thon te/

sgrub pa pos ji srid byang chub ma thob kyis bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad/ bzlog pa byed na slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod cig byas/ hūṃ zhes khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs nas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad par gyur/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra he ru ka naṃ/ oṃ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra he ru ka tsakra brti/ sarba lo ki ta lo korta ra ni/ yan tra man tra ran tra tsur+ṇa pra yo ga rī ne/ ye na ke na tsit+k+ri tā naṃ/ sarbān/ ā kadaḍh+ya ā kadaḍh+ya/ tap+dzā ya tap+dzā ya/ gṛh+ṇa grih+ṇa/ bha k+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ k+ṣ+maṃ k+ṣ+maṃ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ ma tha ma tha/ bi dh+wan+sa ya/ bi dh+yan+sa ya/ sha ta sa ha sra/ tsur+ṇā ya tsur+ṇā ya/ oṃ badz+ra he ru koṣ+ti ṣa tsakra brti/ ta s+ya ba mu kha tsak+ṣu ban+da ban+da hūṃ hūṃ/ a mu ka s+ya <ma ma zhes pa 'don pa spo mchan3gt; shān tiṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes drag tu bzla'o/ /dmigs pa'i gnad rnams man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /de'i mthar bden stobs brjod cing smod pa gdab pa ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang= zhes pa nas/ ma rung pa rnams tshar bcod shog gi bar/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa rwa lugs kyi ngag 'don yig chung du bshad pa bzhin bya/ 'od gsal du bsdu'am mi bsdu skabs dang sbyar/ bkra shis dang smon lam gang 'grub bya'o/ /yang rdo rje phag mo'i rnal 'byor la bsten pa'i phyir bzlog byed na/ skyabs sems nas tshur 'dus sor sor thim pa las/ dbus su rang nyid khro bo che/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ni/ / ser po steng du gdugs dkar can/ /phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'bar ba bskor/ / g.yon pa sbrul zhags sdigs mdzub can/ /shar du sngo skya khwa gdong ma/ /byang du ljang skya 'ug gdong ma/ /nub tu dmar skya khyi gdong ma/ /lho phyogs ser skya phag gdong ma/ /shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ /lho nub gshin rje pho nya ma/

/ nub byang gshin rje che ba ma/ /byang shar gshin rje 'joms ma rnams/ /phyogs mdog dbang gis phyed gzugs can/ /steng dang 'og tu khwa gdong dang*/ khyi gdong ma yang rnam par gnas/ /de ltar de rnams thams cad kyang*/ /rab khros spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs nas/ 'bar 'phreng 'khrug pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ /gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba yi/ /thugs ka rab tu yangs pa'i nang*/ /e las chos 'byung gru gsum dbus/ /'khor lo dmar po rtsibs drug la/ /rdo rje phag mo gshin rje ma/ /rmongs byed ma dang skyod byed ma/ /skrag byed ma dang tsaṇ+ḍi ka /'khor lo'i lte ba zlum po la/ /rang sems baṃ yig gyur pa las/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /sku mdog dmar mo zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / ces pa'i bar brjod/ des mtshon nas rdo rje phag mo'i rigs gang la sbyar kyang 'dra/ lha thams cad kyi snying gar oṃ oṃ ha/ zhes pa nas/ gsungs shing dbang bskur/ zhes pa'i bar snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ khro bo'i zhes pa la lha tshogs zhes pa mdun du byon zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ gtso mo dang rnal 'byor ma drug la mi bskyod pa/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba la rnam snang*/ 'khor gzhan rnams la don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan/ ar+ghaṃ= la sogs pa'i mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ hrīḥ'ajigs byed= sogs la/ he ru ka dpal zhes pa rnal 'byor ma dpal zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba gong bzhin gyis kyang bstod do/ /de nas oṃ gsum ma lta bu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags snying po skabs su gang babs de dang*/ sum bha= mang du bzlas/ bh+ruṃ zhes bya ba'ang mang du brjod nas/ oṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra bār+thi badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ ka ka s+ya la sogs pa yang mang du bzlas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ ces pa nas/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad/

de nas spro na gong bzhin mchod bstod tshar gcig bya/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa 'i sngags la/ badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa'i gnas gsum du/ badz+ra bā ra hī/ zhes pa bcug ste drag tu bzla'o/ /phag mo las bcu'i gzhung na gsang 'dus uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i sngags la/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra bārti/ zhes pa'i sngon du/ badz+ra bā ra hi/ zhes 'don pa dang*/ steng 'og gi khro mo mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma yin par mdzad pas/ spyir ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du byas pas chog kyang*/ skabs su babs pa ni 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi bshad rgyud las byung ba yin pas/ gong du smos pa'i sngags la 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ /yang rdo rje phag mo'i phyir bzlog 'di la/ khro bo gtsug tor gong du smos pa'i dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug par sgom na'ang legs la gtsug tor 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba'i tshab tu 'chi med rdo rje lha mo sgom na'ang shin tu legs pa dang*/ rdo rje lha mo kho na la brten te phyir bzlog byas kyang rung ba yin no/ /de dag gi don rgyas par bde mchog khro bo rnam rol tu bshad zin pa ltar yang legs par rtogs na 'phrin las mtha' yas bsgrub tu rung ngo*/ /zhes pa 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum la brten pa'i bsrung bzlog gi ngag 'don yig chung 'di yang*/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bde mchog uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i ngag 'don khyer bde ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 382--PAGE 381--PAGE 375-
